sections.heading: Product Description
sections.text: Product Description Experience the versatility and comfort of Sleepyhead Flip, the mattress that offers you two choices in one. With its unique design, you can easily find the perfect fit for your sleep preferences. On one side of the mattress, you'll discover a soft and plush feel that gently cradles your body. Sink into a cloud-like embrace as you drift off to sleep, surrounded by luxurious soft foam. This side is perfect for those who enjoy a softer, more cushioned sleeping surface with a medium-firm feel. But what if you prefer a firmer level of support? Simply flip the mattress over, and you'll be greeted by the other side, designed to provide a firm and supportive feel. Experience the gentle yet firm support that keeps your body aligned and promotes a restful night's sleep. With Sleepyhead Flip, you no longer have to compromise on finding the right fit for you. This innovative mattress offers you two options, two chances to discover the perfect level of comfort and support tailored to your needs. Whether you prefer a soft and plush experience or a firm and supportive feel, Sleepyhead Flip has you covered. Embrace the freedom of choice with Sleepyhead Flip, where you can effortlessly switch between two mattresses in one. Say goodbye to restless nights and hello to the perfect sleep experience that suits your unique preferences. Elevate your comfort and enjoy the best of both worlds with Sleepyhead Flip. sections.heading: Who says you can't have it all?
sections.text: Who says you can't have it all? Experience the perfect balance of comfort and support with the Sleepyhead Flip mattress. Its innovative design incorporates carefully selected layers to provide you with a night of uninterrupted sleep. The top layer features a soft knit fabric with loose pores that effectively wick away body humidity, ensuring a fresh and breathable sleep environment. This, combined with the plushy soft foam layer, creates a cozy and cushiony feel that adapts to your body, regardless of your sleeping position. For individuals seeking additional support, the mattress includes a layer of hard foam. This firm layer offers exceptional support, making it ideal for those with back pain or those who prefer a more supportive sleep surface. It’s time to take a side The Soft Side Indulge in the ultimate cozy experience with the Sleepyhead Flip mattress's soft side. Designed to cradle you in comfort, this side of the mattress features a plush comfort layer that provides a gentle cushioning effect. Sink into the mattress like a warm cocoon as it contours to your body, enveloping you in softness. Whether you enjoy a cloud-like feel or prefer a softer sleeping surface, the soft side of the Sleepyhead Flip mattress offers the perfect solution. So, go ahead and flip to the softer side to experience a blissful and luxurious sleep that feels like a dream. The Firm Side Experience exceptional support and alignment with the Sleepyhead Flip mattress's firm side. When you crave a sturdy and stable sleeping surface, simply flip the mattress to unveil its firm side. Crafted with high-density foam layers, this side provides optimal support that helps align your body in a natural and comfortable position. Whether you prefer a firmer feel or need extra support for your back, the firm side of the Sleepyhead Flip mattress is designed to deliver. Enjoy the confidence of a well-supported sleep as you rest peacefully on this side, knowing that your body is properly aligned for a rejuvenating night's rest.

sections.heading: FAQs
sections.text: FAQs 1. What is Flip – Dual‑Sided Foam Mattress with Firm & Soft Sides? Flip is a Sleepyhead high‑density foam mattress designed with two distinct fiirmness sides: one soft and plush, and one firm and supportive, giving you dual side comfort options in a single mattress. 2. What problem does Flip solve? With Sleepyhead Flip, you no longer have to compromise on finding the right fit for you. It solves the problem of being unsure whether you prefer a soft or firm mattress by letting you flip the mattress to the softer side if you like plush like comfort or to the firm side if you need more back support and alignment. 3. Who is Flip best for? Flip is best for people who want flexibility in firmness, side sleepers who like the soft side for cushioning, and back or stomach sleepers who prefer the firm side for spinal support. 4. How does Flip work? The mattress has a soft comfort‑foam layer on one side for a plush, contouring feel and a high‑density, hard foam layer on the other side for strong support; you simply flip it over to switch between the two feels. It is covered with Soft knit fabric ensuring breathable and fresh sleep environment. 5. How is Flip different from alternatives? Unlike a standard single‑firmness foam mattress, Flip offers truly dual‑sided comfort: soft and firm. You can change your support level without buying a new mattress. It features soft knit fabric that wicks away moisture. It has long lasting foam with anti sagging technology that ensures durability. 6. How does Flip feel? The soft side is plush, cushiony and gives you cloud like comfort, while the firm side feels supportive and stable. 7. Does Flip come with a warranty? Yes, Flip comes with a 7‑year warranty and 100 nights trial. 8. How to care for Flip? To care for Flip, use a breathable mattress protector, keep it on a flat, supportive base, rotate periodically if recommended, avoid folding or standing on the mattress.
